liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **One More Saturday Night 1 (inc)** (1 other source): First rough mix is incomplete, as the reel stops at 2:51, but it has the full count-in and some Weir commentary [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **One More Saturday Night 1 (inc)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [3]
- **One More Saturday Night 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [3]
- **One More Saturday Night 3**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [3]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-03-01.152205.OMSNRoughMixes.studio.bershaw.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 3 songs; 12 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording has some extremely bright tones, at least to this reviewer's ears [2]

## Around the show

- These are rough reference mixes for Bob Weir's Ace album; the second and third mixes are complete, with no count-in [1]
- All three mixes predate the horn section overdubs and differ in other ways from the released Ace track [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-03-01.152205.OMSNRoughMixes.studio.bershaw.flac16**: transferred by Alan Bershaw; source: Alan Bershaw's low generation cassette (Maxell UDXL2 w/Dolby B) [1]
